author: Huawei
description:
How can digitalization drive real economic growth?
 
In this Transform Talks interview, Sherzod Shermatov, Minister of Digital Technologies of Uzbekistan, shares how the country is building a business-friendly environment, scaling digital public services, and investing in skills to create high-quality jobs.
 
From education reform to AI-driven infrastructure and global partnerships, Uzbekistan is positioning itself as a hub for talent in a fast-changing digital economy.
 
Watch the full conversation at #MWC26: https://bit.ly/4tr3GvY #Huawei #TransformTalks #ThisIsHuawei
title: Building a Digital Economy: Uzbekistan's Growth Strategy
